description: extend my lease for another term
utterances: lease is up soon id like to stay another year
My current agreement ends at the end of next month and I am happy here, so I would like to sign on for a further twelve months if possible.

description: leave before my lease term ends
utterances: got a job in another city need out of my contract
I still have seven months left on my agreement but circumstances have changed and I have to move away, what are my options for breaking it?

description: give notice that i am moving out at lease end
utterances: wont be renewing im leaving when the term is up
My agreement finishes in two months and I have decided to relocate, so consider this my formal notification that I will be vacating on the final day.

description: continue month to month after the fixed term ends
utterances: can i just go monthly once the year is done
I am not ready to commit to another full year but do not want to leave either, would you let me continue on a rolling arrangement for now?

description: add another person to my lease
utterances: my partner is moving in can she be on the contract
A friend will be sharing the flat with me from next month and we both want to be legally responsible for it, how do we get him included?

description: take a departing roommate off the lease
utterances: my flatmate moved out want his name off the agreement
The person I was sharing with has left for good and I am staying on alone, so I need the contract updated so only I am on it.

description: get permission to sublet my unit
utterances: going abroad for six months can someone rent my place meanwhile
I will be working overseas until next summer and would like to let a colleague live here and cover the rent while I am away, is that allowed?

description: hand my lease over to a replacement tenant
utterances: found someone to take over my contract fully can we swap
I have to leave permanently and a coworker is willing to step into my agreement for the remaining term, can the paperwork be put in her name instead?

description: report a water leak in my unit
utterances: theres water dripping from the ceiling in the bathroom
Since last night there has been a steady drip coming through the kitchen ceiling and a puddle is forming on the floor, someone needs to look at it urgently.

description: report that there is no hot water
utterances: shower has been freezing cold for two days
The boiler seems to be running but only cold comes out of every tap in the flat, we have not been able to wash properly since Sunday.

description: report that the heating does not work
utterances: radiators are stone cold and its freezing in here
None of the radiators in the apartment warm up no matter what I set the dial to, and with the temperature dropping this week it is becoming unbearable.

description: report a broken appliance that came with the unit
utterances: the oven you provided stopped working completely
The washing machine that was in the flat when I moved in makes a loud grinding noise and no longer spins, I believe it is your responsibility to fix.

description: report pests in my apartment
utterances: keep seeing cockroaches in the kitchen at night
Over the past week I have found mouse droppings in the cupboards and heard scratching in the walls, can you send an exterminator to deal with it?

description: report mold growing in the unit
utterances: black spots spreading across the bedroom wall
There is a dark fuzzy patch growing behind the wardrobe and around the window frame and my kid has started coughing, I think it is a damp problem.

description: ask when a reported repair will be done
utterances: any news on the leak i reported last week
I put in a maintenance request for the broken window over two weeks ago and nobody has come or called, can you tell me when it is scheduled?

description: ask when my deposit will be returned
utterances: moved out two weeks ago still havent got my bond back
I handed the keys in at the end of last month and left the place spotless, how long does it usually take before the security amount is sent back?

description: dispute deductions taken from my deposit
utterances: you kept half my deposit for a carpet that was already stained
The statement I received charges me for repainting the flat, but the walls were in the same condition as when I moved in and I have photos.

description: get an itemized breakdown of deposit deductions
utterances: why did i only get part of my deposit back
The amount returned to me was lower than what I paid at the start and nobody explained why, I would like a written list of every charge.

description: get an assigned parking spot in the building
utterances: just bought a car is there a space i can use
I have started driving to work and street parking around here is impossible, does the building have a bay I could rent along with the flat?

description: someone else is parked in my assigned spot
utterances: theres a strange car in my bay again
For the third time this week I have come home to find an unknown vehicle in the space I pay for, can you have it moved or towed?

description: get a temporary parking pass for a guest
utterances: my parents are visiting where can they leave their car
I have family staying with me for the weekend and they are driving down, is there some way to let them use the residents lot without being ticketed?

description: complain about noise from a neighboring unit
utterances: the people upstairs are stomping around till three am every night
The flat next door has had parties several nights a week for the past month and the shouting through the wall keeps my children awake, please intervene.

description: complain about noise from renovation work in the building
utterances: the drilling in the unit below starts at seven every morning
Contractors have been hammering and sawing in the apartment above since last week, starting before eight and going all day, is there a limit on working hours?

description: have the locks on my door changed
utterances: my ex still has a key i want new locks
Since I broke up with the person I used to live with I no longer feel safe knowing they could get in, could the front door cylinder be replaced?

description: get back in after locking myself out
utterances: shut the door behind me and my keys are inside
I stepped out to take the rubbish down and the door latched behind me, I am standing in the hallway with no way in, can someone let me in?

description: get an additional key or entry fob
utterances: can i get a spare key for my sister
My partner has moved in and we only have one set between us, which is a nuisance, could a second set of keys and a fob be issued?

description: report that the building entry door does not lock
utterances: front door of the building just swings open anyone can walk in
The main entrance downstairs has not latched properly for a week and strangers have been getting into the lobby, this is a security issue for all of us.

description: schedule the final walkthrough before moving out
utterances: when can you come check the flat before i leave
I am handing the place back at the end of the month and want to arrange a time for you to inspect it so there are no surprises.

description: ask permission to keep a pet
utterances: would you be ok with me getting a small dog
I am thinking about adopting a cat from the shelter and want to check first whether that is acceptable under my agreement or needs an extra clause.

description: ask to paint or make small changes to the unit
utterances: mind if i repaint the bedroom a different colour
I would like to put up some shelves and swap the light fittings in the living room, do I need your written approval before doing that?

description: question a rent increase notice
utterances: you want fifteen percent more from next month thats too much
The letter I got says my monthly amount is going up well beyond what neighbouring flats pay, I would like to discuss this before agreeing to anything.

description: complain that someone entered my unit without notice
utterances: came home and someone had clearly been inside my flat
Twice this month a maintenance person has let themselves in while I was at work with no warning at all, I expect to be told in advance.
